clips.send: Send this to someone who doom-scrolls and calls it staying informed - names exactly why the feed feels that way, a little anger at being managed.
clips.caption:
Tell someone about a great movie you saw and they might mention it once. Tell them it was terrible and they'll bring it up for a week.

That's not an accident of taste. Negativity spreads faster than positivity, every single time, and the news figured that out before you did. Almost any story could be reported neutrally, sometimes even positively.

It doesn't get reported that way, because negative sells and positive doesn't. The slant isn't a bug in the system. It is the system.
